title: Containerization and Deployment Concepts knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best captures the central idea of “Containerization and Deployment Concepts”?
options: The method proves that every prediction will be correct on all future datasets.
The method removes the need to inspect data quality or define an evaluation strategy.
The method always performs better than a simple baseline, regardless of the task.
A persisted model is a versioned software artifact. Load only trusted files, pin compatible package versions, validate input schemas, and test the complete prediction path.
questions.answer_key: A persisted model is a versioned software artifact. Load only trusted files, pin compatible package versions, validate input schemas, and test the complete prediction path.
questions.explanation: The lesson frames the topic this way: A persisted model is a versioned software artifact. Load only trusted files, pin compatible package versions, validate input schemas, and test the complete prediction path. The other options make unsupported guarantees.

questions.prompt: What is a sound first step when applying “Containerization and Deployment Concepts” to a new task?
options: Remove records that produce unexpected outcomes without investigating them.
Assume the default parameters are best for every dataset.
Name the inputs, assumptions, and output for Packaging model dependencies; then test it on representative data.
Tune against the final test set until the preferred metric increases.
questions.answer_key: Name the inputs, assumptions, and output for Packaging model dependencies; then test it on representative data.
questions.explanation: Define the input, output, assumptions, and evidence needed. For Packaging model dependencies, a small representative check is more useful than blind tuning.

questions.prompt: What conclusion is appropriately cautious after trying “Containerization and Deployment Concepts”?
options: An internal estimator score replaces domain review and operational monitoring.
A successful small example is useful evidence about that example, but generalization, risks, and limitations still need separate checks.
A single successful run proves fairness, robustness, and production readiness.
A higher training score alone proves generalization to unseen data.
questions.answer_key: A successful small example is useful evidence about that example, but generalization, risks, and limitations still need separate checks.
questions.explanation: A demonstration only supports conclusions within its scope. Evaluate representative unseen cases and report limitations before production use.
